name: IIWA World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The top prize of the International Internet Wrestling Association's first 1998 incarnation, billed for monthly defense against a top-five contender -- announced in the fed's own founding handbook.

name: IIWA World Television Championship
epitaph: The secondary singles title of the International Internet Wrestling Association's first 1998 incarnation, billed for weekly defense -- announced in the fed's own founding handbook.

name: IIWA World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The tag team title of the International Internet Wrestling Association's first 1998 incarnation -- announced in the fed's own founding handbook.
